title: mapspec model specification
description: Declarative source-to-target mapping for one target model. Validated before anything is generated.

allOf.comment: A generated model declares no sources and no columns.

keyExpressionList.description: One SQL expression, or an ordered list of them for a composite key. A bare string is treated as a one-element list.

build_platforms.description: Tier-1 platforms this spec is validated, emitted, built and compared on. Absent means every tier-1 platform. A spec that exercises a construct substituted on one platform but honored on another lists only the platforms that honor it, so the suite can keep coverage of the honored path without the substituted path failing the build. Not an emitter construct; build infrastructure.

specialMembers.description: Project-level registry of the keys a failed lookup resolves to. Declared once so a code means the same thing in every dimension. Absent means the defaults below.

reserved_floor.description: Inclusive floor of the reserved band [reserved_floor, -1]. A member code may equal it. Sequences start at 1 and the sign keeps them clear, except under strategy: hash.

timestampPolicy.description: Estate-wide temporal discipline. Effectivity is always timestamp(3) holding UTC.

zone_representation.description: An offset reconstructs past intent exactly. Future-dated effectivity requires the zone id.

natural_key_stability.description: unstable means the source identifier can change or be reassigned, which forces a crosswalk durable key.

as_of.description: Fact only. The single point-in-time column driving every Type-2 lookup in this model.

holiday_flags.description: Must stay false in a multi-country estate. Holidays belong in dim_calendar_date.

strategy.description: sequence is the default. A point-in-time lookup joins the dimension anyway, so a computable key buys nothing. hash survives only for parallel assignment with no central sequence.

hash_positivity.description: Required under strategy: hash. keyType is signed, so a hash cast into it lands negative about half the time and collides with the reserved band, producing a real row whose key is a member code. This declares how the value is forced positive. Not generated yet; nothing generates hash keys.

change_hash.description: Hash over Type 2 columns only, computed AFTER survivorship. Decides whether to open a version. Including a Type 6 current column here re-versions the whole entity on every change.

attribute_hash.description: Hash over every column maintained in place (types 1, 3 current, 5 outrigger, 6 current). Decides whether to update.

source.description: Source alias. Two timelines may feed one attribute from different systems; survivorship resolves.

before_first.description: Required. There is no safe default for the span before an attribute's first known value.

strategy.description: Required: say how the durable key is assigned, so the emitter is never silently handed a default. sequence is what the emitter emits, a dense_rank per entity. crosswalk resolves identity through a persistent mapping and hash_natural_key hashes the natural key; both are substituted today because the emitter emits a sequence, which is not durable across refreshes, so declaring either fails the build.

on_unknown.description: assign_new mints a durable key, error stops, any other value is a special member name resolved on the same terms as a lookup route.

lateArrival.description: Data arriving with an effective instant inside an already closed interval.

mode.description: retroactive_insert shortens the preceding version's valid_to and inserts a new version. Surrogate keys of existing versions are unchanged because the hash is over effective_from.

affected_facts.description: Facts loaded in the window the new version now covers point at the superseded version.

max_backdating.description: ISO 8601 duration. An arrival older than this is rejected rather than silently rewriting history.

update_timestamp.description: Required when any survivorship rule uses most_recent.

projectionColumn.description: After projection every source looks like a flat table. Column transforms never reference a path.

from.description: Delimited or fixed width: ordinal position or header name.

as_text.description: Required true for a decimal of more than 15 significant digits crossing a JSON hop.

temporalKeys.description: Resolves the zone once at load so cross-geography local-time analysis needs no query-time conversion.

tCast.description: Separated from expression because it generates without authored SQL, transpiles cleanly, and is checkable for precision loss.

format.description: Parse mask. A mask with no fractional seconds under a millisecond target is a warning.

tLookup.description: Point-in-time dimension lookup. Join mechanics come from the dimension's own scd block, never restated here.

natural_key.description: The fact-side key, one expression per column of the dimension's natural key. A bare string is one element. Matched positionally against the dimension's natural key; the lengths must agree.

dimension_natural_key.description: The dimension-side key columns, when the generator cannot resolve them from the dimension spec in this emit run. A bare string is one element. When both are available the validator checks they agree.

as_of.description: Omit to inherit target.as_of. Override only when this one lookup genuinely differs.

on_null_key.description: The source natural key arrived null. A source problem, distinct from a value that will not resolve.

on_miss.description: The key is not in the dimension at all. Reference data problem.

on_no_version.description: The key exists but no version covers the as-of instant. The entity is known; the question was asked at the wrong time.

memberRoute.description: A special member name from the registry, or the literals 'null' or 'error'. The validator checks the name against the registry.

tSurvived.description: Value resolved by the model's survivorship rules across multiple contributing sources.

tUnresolved.description: First class. Emits a TODO, counts in the coverage report, renders red in review. The converter never guesses.

hashPolicy.description: Content hashing for change detection and existence. Never used for surrogate keys.

storage.description: Hex, lower case. The hash lives only on dimension rows, never on a fact, so readability during a reconciliation beats width.

strip_prefix.description: Some platforms return 0x-prefixed hex. Strip it or cross-platform comparison never matches.

timestamp_format.description: Explicit. Implicit rendering uses session settings, so one row hashes differently from two sessions.

currentView.description: Type 7 in practice. Join the base on the surrogate for as-was, this view on the durable key for as-is.

oneOf.description: Legacy spelling. track is type 2, overwrite is type 1.

paired_with.description: Type 0 only. The live column this original value sits beside.

miniDimension.description: Type 4. Rapid changers split out so they do not drive versioning of the base dimension.

banding_required.description: Continuous attributes must be banded or the mini-dimension's cardinality defeats its purpose.

outrigger.description: Type 5. A Type 1 pointer on the base dimension to the current mini-dimension row.
